name: David Crown (HON)
title: Co-Chairman & Co-Founder
short: David Crown is the Co-Chairman and Co-Founder of Pactum Crownstone United Global Inc. A distinguished Financier and institutional architect, he brings decades of sovereign advisory experience across global capital markets.
full: David Crown operates at the intersection of capital, systems, and global strategy, engaging in the design and direction of structures that underpin modern financial activity. He is generally regarded as someone who works beyond the visible edges of conventional finance, with his name occasionally surfacing in connection with outcomes that tend to precede broader recognition rather than follow it. His work is not defined by visibility, but by influence - shaping flows, frameworks, and opportunities across jurisdictions with a focus on scale, longevity, and structural advantage. Over time, he has moved beyond conventional roles, shifting from active participation in ventures to a more measured position centered on alignment, architecture, and long-range positioning. Those familiar with his approach note that his involvement is rarely direct in the traditional sense, yet often material in how situations ultimately take shape. Rather than participating in established models, he has focused on building and aligning new ones - developing mechanisms that allow for more fluid interaction between markets, technologies, and capital sources. These efforts often sit slightly outside established frameworks, emerging over time as functional realities within evolving financial environments. Operating internationally, he is understood to engage with a small, distributed network of counterparties, institutions, and builders, where discretion is implicit, and access is tightly held. Within these circles, emphasis is placed less on activity and more on timing, structure, and continuity. Observers tend to note a preference for operating without attribution, allowing outcomes to speak independently of authorship. His presence is therefore most visible in the systems he helps shape and the results they produce, rather than through direct association. What ultimately defines his position is not any single role or enterprise, but a consistent pattern of involvement in matters where scale, discretion, and long-term orientation converge - quietly positioning capital and capability where they will matter most over time.

name: Eliot Tawil
title: Co-Chairman
short: Eliot Tawil serves as Co-Chairman of Pactum Crownstone United Global Inc. A veteran real estate and capital markets executive, Mr. Tawil brings a distinguished track record across global institutional platforms, overseeing the deployment of billions in institutional capital across commercial, residential, and mixed-use assets.
full: Eliot Tawil is a seasoned real estate professional with over 35 years of experience specializing in the retail and office sectors. Over the past three decades, Eliot has built a reputation as a sharp dealmaker, strategic thinker, and trusted partner in the world of commercial real estate. His career began in 1991 as a regional director for Payless ShoeSource, where he earned Rookie of the Year honors after opening 60 stores in just 18 months - a pace that quickly drew attention from major retail brands seeking expansion leadership. After successfully rolling out 20 locations for Einstein Bros. Bagels, Eliot made a pivotal move in 1997 by shifting from tenant representation to ownership, joining forces with Jeff Sutton at Wharton Properties. Over the next 30 years, he helped amass a portfolio of over 140 premier retail assets and personally procured over 400 unique deals - many in high-stakes, competitive markets like New York City. Known for his ability to create upside through strategic repositioning, Eliot has mastered the art of navigating complex tenant negotiations, entitlement hurdles, and value-add development. One standout project included buying out 24 office tenants and 3 retailers with long-term leases on the corner of Broadway & John Street in Manhattan, making way for a 26-story Pace University dormitory and an 8,000-square-foot Urban Outfitters. Eliot's hands-on approach and deep knowledge of urban markets have enabled him to work closely with leading architects and engineers, designing properties that unlock additional square footage and long-term value. His sharp negotiating skills and experience handling every facet of the deal lifecycle - from tenant buyouts to site assembly and redevelopment - have made him a force in the industry. Most recently, Eliot co-founded Encore NYC with Brandon Hanna of Encore Real Estate, a 1031 exchange expert and the largest seller of Rite Aid properties in the country. Together, they're capitalizing on today's unprecedented market reset - driven by widespread retail closures - to acquire and repurpose prime real estate at distressed levels. With access to thousands of sites across the U.S., including former locations for Rite Aid, Walgreens, JCPenney, and more, Encore NYC is executing national rollout strategies for fast-growing brands. Eliot believes that the shifting landscape presents unparalleled opportunities for those willing to act boldly. With a proven track record, national reach, and a forward-looking mindset, he remains bullish on retail real estate as a destination for the smart money. Eliot also owns a number of world-leading defense companies.

name: Todd Ruppert
title: Non-Executive Co-Chairman
short: Todd Ruppert serves as Non-Executive Co-Chairman of Pactum Crownstone United Global Inc. He is the former CEO of T. Rowe Price Global Investment Services and brings over 40 years of global investment management experience, having overseen more than $1.7 trillion in assets under management.
full: Todd Ruppert is a highly respected global financial services executive with more than four decades of leadership experience across investment management, venture capital, and institutional strategy. As Chairman of Pactum Investment Group, he provides strategic oversight across the firm's global platform, guiding long-term vision, governance, and capital positioning. Mr. Ruppert is the Founder and CEO of Ruppert International, a diversified enterprise spanning financial services, venture capital, education, and the arts. He previously served as CEO and President of T. Rowe Price Global Investment Services, as well as Co-President of T. Rowe Price International, where he was part of the leadership team overseeing more than $1.7 trillion in assets under management. Following his executive career, he became a Venture Partner at Greenspring Associates, contributing to one of the world's leading venture capital platforms. He continues to advise more than 20 venture capital and private equity firms across multiple continents, supporting investment strategy and institutional growth. In addition to his investment work, Mr. Ruppert serves on numerous boards globally, including the World Trade Center Institute and the Royal Parks Foundation (USA). His leadership extends into philanthropy, education, and the arts, reflecting a broader commitment to global impact. At Pactum IG, Mr. Ruppert brings unparalleled institutional experience, global connectivity, and strategic insight, positioning the firm for sustained growth and leadership across international investment markets.

name: Dr. Victoria (Grace) Vysotina
title: Non-Executive Co-Chairman
short: Dr. Victoria (Grace) Vysotina serves as Non-Executive Co-Chairman of Pactum Crownstone United Global Inc. A senior wealth management executive and economist, she brings deep expertise in European and CIS institutional capital, having held senior roles at UBS Wealth Management and Morgan Stanley's Family Office Group.
full: Dr. Victoria Vysotina is a globally experienced investor, Chief Investment Officer level advisor, and senior financial strategist with nearly three decades of experience across investment banking, asset management, and family office advisory. She currently serves as a senior advisor at UBS Wealth Management, where she works with prominent international families and institutions, acting as a de facto CIO - overseeing complex portfolios, sourcing private market opportunities, and designing bespoke investment frameworks across asset classes. Previously, Dr. Vysotina was Managing Director and Head of Investments for Morgan Stanley's Family Office Group, where she led investment strategy and portfolio construction for ultra-high-net-worth clients and oversaw multi-billion-dollar allocations across public and private markets. She has also served as Chief Investment Officer to a major single-family office and held senior investment roles at the Rockefeller Foundation and HSBC's Alternative Investment Group, contributing to large-scale hedge fund and private equity platforms. Her expertise spans private equity, venture capital, real assets, hedge funds, and structured credit, with a strong focus on risk management, portfolio construction, and cross-border capital allocation. Earlier in her career, she worked in fixed income and capital markets at Merrill Lynch, Credit Suisse, and Morgan Stanley, advising on complex global transactions. Dr. Vysotina holds a Ph.D. in Mathematics from Emory University and is an active supporter of education, serving on the advisory board of the Museum of Mathematics (MoMath) in New York. At Pactum Crownstone, she brings deep institutional investment insight, global family office connectivity, and strategic leadership to support the firm's growth, capital formation, and investment platform development.

name: Benjamin Jordan
title: Co-Founder & Co-Managing Director
short: Benjamin Jordan is Co-Founder and Co-Managing Director of Pactum Crownstone United Global Inc. A senior investment professional with a background spanning private equity, sovereign advisory, and Islamic finance, he holds a BSc in International Relations from the University of London and is a Freeman of the Worshipful Company of International Bankers.
full: Benjamin Jordan is an investment executive specializing in the structuring and deployment of institutional capital across private equity and broader private markets. As Co-Founder and Managing Director of Pactum & Crownstone United Global Inc., he leads the firm's strategy to design and execute large-scale public-private partnership platforms aligned with U.S. government capital and policy priorities. Mr. Jordan's experience centers on originating and structuring complex transactions, building institutional investment platforms, and aligning sovereign and private capital with long-term strategic objectives. His work spans cross-border capital formation, partnership development, and the execution of investment strategies across multiple sectors within the private markets landscape. He began his career in private equity with Endeavour, where he focused on U.S. mid-market investments, contributing to deal sourcing, transaction execution, and portfolio development. Mr. Jordan is a Freeman of the Worshipful Company of International Bankers, reflecting his engagement with the global financial community and longstanding ties to the City of London. He holds a BSc (Hons) in International Relations and Politics from the University of London and completed the International Baccalaureate at Wellington College. He also holds the Level 3 Certificate in Islamic Finance (IFQ) from The Chartered Institute for Securities & Investment.

name: Greg Hutton
title: Co-Founder & Co-Managing Partner
short: Greg Hutton is Co-Founder and Co-Managing Partner of Pactum Crownstone United Global Inc. A senior investment professional with over two decades of experience across global private equity and investment banking, he is a Founding Member of SFO Alliance and serves on the board of Vesper Wealth Advisors.
full: Greg Hutton is a senior investment professional with over two decades of experience across global private equity, investment banking, and family office platforms. As Managing Partner of Pactum Capital, he oversees the firm's investment strategy and execution across private equity, strategic growth ventures, opportunistic real estate, and special situations in both developed and frontier markets. The firm operates globally with a presence in New York, London, Zurich, Doha, and Kuala Lumpur, and is supported by longstanding institutional and family-backed capital. Mr. Hutton serves on the board of Vesper Wealth Advisors, a family office-focused wealth advisory platform based in Abu Dhabi Global Market. He is also a Founding Member of SFO Alliance, the world's largest peer-to-peer network for single-family offices, and an active member of Heritage and Club b, global platforms for family office principals and next-generation leaders. Earlier in his career, Mr. Hutton was a Partner at Demira Gate Investments, a private family office investment firm, and previously a Partner at a London-based private investment firm focused on venture capital and private equity. He began his career in investment banking, holding senior roles at RBS and Citigroup, where he specialized in mergers and acquisitions, capital markets, and strategic investments across the UK, U.S., and Europe. Mr. Hutton also serves as a Non-Executive Director of AFL Europe, contributing to the strategic development and commercialization of the sport across European markets.

name: Mark Johnson
title: Co-Managing Partner
short: Mark Johnson serves as Co-Managing Partner of Pactum Crownstone United Global Inc. A dynamic executive with more than three decades at the intersection of sports, entertainment, media, and technology, he pioneered the NFL Players Association's licensing strategy and grew NASCAR's licensing revenues from $500,000 to over $2 billion.
full: Mark Johnson has spent more than three decades at the intersection of sports, entertainment, media, and technology, building businesses, launching categories, and creating measurable value at a scale few executives can claim. He brings a rare combination of creative vision and commercial discipline - a leader who has turned ideas into institutions and partnerships into billion-dollar revenue streams. His career is defined not by a single industry, but by an extraordinary ability to identify opportunity across industries and build the infrastructure to capture it. Early in his career, Johnson pioneered the licensing strategy for the NFL Players Association, structuring the first-ever initiative of its kind for the NFLPA and generating over one billion dollars in licensing and event revenue within three years. Around the same time, he was building a similarly transformative playbook for NASCAR - developing its first integrated marketing, media, and licensing strategy and growing the organization's licensing revenues from $500,000 to more than two billion dollars in just four years. At PRIMEDIA Communications, the agency he founded and led for fifteen years, he served as the marketing and licensing architect for some of the world's most recognized brands - Coca-Cola, McDonald's, Pepsi, American Express, and Miller Brewing - while simultaneously expanding the Montreux Jazz Festival into a major international cultural event. PRIMEDIA's successful exit to Carousel Capital and KKR validated what Johnson had built: a premier creative and commercial engine serving Fortune 500 clients on a global stage. In the early 2000s, Johnson founded Smart System Technologies and raised venture capital to launch one of North America's first large-scale contactless payment and loyalty platforms, securing partnerships with the Detroit Lions, Philadelphia Eagles, and Seattle Seahawks before a successful acquisition by MasterCard. Through Align Entertainment Group and Equity Management Group, he has delivered 360-degree brand building, licensing, and touring services for artists including Andrea Bocelli, Celine Dion, Oprah Winfrey, Stevie Wonder, David Foster, Michael Bublé, Earth Wind & Fire, Mary J. Blige, the LA Philharmonic, the House of Blues, and the Beijing Music Festival. His production work includes the landmark Nurse Heroes Live! broadcast on NBC Peacock, the Hitman and Hitman Returns concert television specials with David Foster, and the first international satellite broadcast in Times Square in 2008. In 1985, he executive produced the first satellite broadcast television simulcast for the inaugural Martin Luther King, Jr. birthday celebration on NBC. His work has earned a Peabody Award, an Emmy Award, recognition from Adweek, and the San Diego International Film Festival's Artistic Director's Award. He was inducted into the Montreux Legends Club in 2019 and has been recognized by the United Nations University for Peace as an Ambassador and Founding Member of the UN Commission for Peace.

name: Mickey Welcher
title: Co-Managing Partner & Co-Chair, Investment Strategy
short: Mickey Welcher serves as Co-Managing Partner and Co-Chair of Investment Strategy at Pactum Crownstone United Global Inc. A seasoned capital markets professional, he has served as Chief Investment Officer across hedge funds and institutional platforms, with expertise spanning equities, fixed income, derivatives, and alternative investments.
full: Mickey Welcher is a seasoned investment professional whose career reflects a lifelong engagement with the financial markets and a disciplined approach to capital allocation across asset classes. He began investing at an early age, managing capital for himself and his family, and quickly developed a foundational understanding of market behavior, risk, and opportunity. Following his graduation from Arizona State University, Mickey entered the financial services industry, gaining early exposure to institutional trading environments. His experience on a high-yield bond desk and on the Pacific Coast Stock Exchange provided him with a strong command of liquidity dynamics, pricing mechanisms, and investor psychology within fast-moving markets. He advanced into senior roles across hedge funds and investment platforms, ultimately serving as Chief Investment Officer. In these positions, he led portfolio construction, risk management, and strategy development across equities, fixed income, derivatives, and alternative investments, consistently delivering disciplined, risk-adjusted performance. At Pactum Crownstone, Mickey plays a central role in shaping investment strategy across private markets, digital assets, and alternative investments. He is instrumental in sourcing differentiated opportunities, structuring investments, and expanding access to institutional-quality strategies. His investment philosophy emphasizes disciplined analysis, diversification, and forward-looking opportunity identification. He remains deeply engaged in market developments, positioning capital to navigate evolving global conditions while capturing long-term value.

name: Courtnie Russell, Esq.
title: Co-Managing Partner & Compliance Director
short: Courtnie Russell, Esq. serves as Co-Managing Partner and Compliance Director of Pactum Crownstone United Global Inc. A licensed attorney and international tax strategist, she holds a JD from Florida A&M University, an LL.M. in Taxation from the University of Baltimore, and is a Loretta Collins Argrett Fellow.
full: Courtnie Russell, Esq. is a licensed Attorney, international tax strategist, and compliance leader operating at the intersection of cross-border capital, regulatory risk, and global investment structuring. She brings a deal-oriented, investor-focused approach to international tax, advising on the efficient deployment and protection of capital across jurisdictions. She is also a vital contributor as International Tax Senior at Windham Brannon LLC, where she leads on complex international tax compliance and advisory matters, including multinational reporting regimes. Her work spans cross-border structuring, entity optimization, and regulatory alignment for high-net-worth individuals, closely held investment vehicles, and globally active enterprises. Courtnie is deeply experienced in tax controversy and regulatory defense, regularly interfacing with the IRS on audits and examinations, and developing sophisticated reasonable cause strategies to mitigate exposure. She operates with a strong understanding of enforcement trends, transparency regimes, and the increasing scrutiny facing international capital flows - making her a strategic asset in both proactive structuring and defensive positioning. Courtnie developed her technical and operational foundation at BDO USA, P.C., where she operated within a global platform delivering large-scale tax compliance and advisory services. She holds a Juris Doctor from Florida A&M University College of Law, an LL.M. in Taxation from the University of Baltimore, and a Master's degree in Accounting. Courtnie is an active member of the State Bar of Georgia, the Atlanta Bar Association, and the American Bar Association Tax Section, where she is a Loretta Collins Argrett Fellow. She has been selected for the Atlanta Bar Association's Inaugural 2025 Leadership Academy and the State Bar of Georgia Young Lawyers Division's 2026 Leadership Academy. She now serves as a key compliance and strategic advisor within the Pactum Crownstone Global Ecosystem, where she plays a central role in overseeing cross-border regulatory integrity, structuring discipline, and institutional-grade compliance frameworks.

name: Daniel Denero
title: Chief Legal Officer & Co-Chair, Global Legal Affairs
short: Daniel Denero serves as Chief Legal Officer and Co-Chair of Global Legal Affairs at Pactum Crownstone United Global Inc. A former Principal at Squire Patton Boggs, he brings deep expertise in high-stakes litigation, regulatory enforcement, and cross-border legal strategy across more than 15 countries.
full: Daniel Denero is a senior legal executive serving as Chief Legal Officer and Co-Chair of Global Legal Affairs at Pactum Crownstone. He brings deep expertise in high-stakes litigation, regulatory enforcement, and cross-border legal strategy, advising organizations and leadership teams on complex, multi-jurisdictional matters. Prior to his executive roles, Denero was a Principal at Squire Patton Boggs, where he led litigation and regulatory matters across a broad spectrum of industries. His practice focused on consumer class actions, including matters under the TCPA and FDCPA, as well as business litigation, contract disputes, and government investigations involving the DOJ, FCC, CFPB, and state attorneys general. Denero is widely recognized for his ability to manage sophisticated disputes spanning multiple jurisdictions, having coordinated legal matters across more than 15 countries. His experience includes handling white-collar defense, securities litigation, and complex class actions for both corporate and individual clients. He began his legal career as a law clerk to a Chief Judge of a United States District Court, where he developed a strong foundation in federal litigation and judicial process.

name: Isaac Barnes
title: Associate Managing Director & Board Strategic Adviser
short: Isaac Barnes serves as Associate Managing Director and Board Strategic Adviser at Pactum Crownstone United Global Inc. A former U.S. Marine Corps officer who has worked within the Pentagon and the Executive Office of the President, he brings over $30 billion in collective deal experience across a global network spanning 110+ countries.
full: Isaac Barnes operates at the intersection of capital deployment, infrastructure, and execution, with a focus on transforming complex, high-value opportunities into structured, investable, and executable outcomes. He serves as a Strategic Adviser and Associate Managing Director at Pactum Crownstone, where he contributes to advancing the firm's mandate across capital formation, strategic transactions, and institutional-grade deal execution. In this role, Isaac supports the alignment of global capital partners, operating platforms, and strategic stakeholders - ensuring that opportunities brought forward meet the clarity, structure, and execution readiness required for commitment at scale. Isaac is also the Founder and CEO of Unified State Group (USG), a deal readiness and structuring firm designed to strengthen active transactions and move them from interest to committed execution. Through USG, he works with founders, sponsors, family offices, operators, and project owners who have real opportunities in motion but require refined structure, aligned stakeholders, credible proof, and a clear capital path. Operating within a globally distributed network spanning more than 110 countries, Isaac engages across transactions ranging from $1 million to over $15 billion, with more than $30 billion in collective deal experience across his network. This ecosystem includes capital providers, government-linked stakeholders, technology partners, operators, and multigenerational families. Over the course of his career, Isaac has been involved in securing and delivering millions of dollars in government contracts and has operated within contract vehicles exceeding $100 billion in support of national-level initiatives. He has worked within the Pentagon and the Executive Office of the President under both Obama and Trump administrations and began his career in the United States Marine Corps, where he developed a foundation in operating within mission-critical environments requiring precision, accountability, and execution under pressure. At both Pactum Crownstone and USG, Isaac applies a structured framework focused on resolving the recurring factors that prevent transactions from reaching commitment - including decision logic, risk allocation, stakeholder alignment, proof, sequencing, and execution readiness.

name: Lisa Rounds
title: Senior Associate Partner
short: Lisa Rounds serves as Senior Associate Partner at Pactum Crownstone United Global Inc. A senior executive with more than three decades of experience across partnership development, investor engagement, and global business growth, she leads the firm's institutional relationship management and capital formation activities.
full: Lisa Rounds is a senior executive and strategic operator with more than three decades of experience across partnership development, investor engagement, and global business growth. She has built a career operating at the intersection of capital, technology, and enterprise strategy, consistently aligning stakeholders to drive measurable commercial outcomes. Her experience spans leadership roles in AI-driven healthcare technology, investment banking, and structured finance advisory, where she has worked closely with executive teams to design and execute growth strategies, lead innovation initiatives, and manage complex, multi-stakeholder environments across the United States and the Middle East. Lisa is recognized for her ability to originate and cultivate high-value relationships across investors, founders, and strategic partners. She has consistently operated as a connector within complex ecosystems, facilitating capital flows and enabling execution across sectors including healthcare, financial services, and emerging technologies. At Pactum Crownstone, she leads strategic partnership development and investor engagement, supporting capital formation and expanding the firm's global network. She plays a central role in sourcing opportunities, strengthening investor relationships, and positioning the firm within institutional and private capital markets. In addition to her executive work, Lisa maintains a significant professional network, including a LinkedIn following of more than 28,000 professionals. This network serves as an extension of her market presence, enabling access, visibility, and relationship development across key investor and operator communities globally. She is particularly valued for her ability to translate relationships into actionable opportunities, bridging capital, strategy, and execution in a way that drives tangible results. She is also known for her ability to navigate highly selective, relationship-driven environments, working closely and discreetly with family offices and private capital groups.

name: David Alfrey
title: Partner & Group General Counsel
short: David Alfrey serves as Partner and Group General Counsel at Pactum Crownstone United Global Inc. A former Partner at Addleshaw Goddard and Clifford Chance LLP, he brings deep expertise in global capital allocation, ESG governance, and institutional investment frameworks, and is Co-Founder of The Impactors.
full: David Alfrey is a senior legal and strategic advisor with deep expertise in global capital allocation, ESG governance, and institutional investment frameworks. As Partner and Group General Counsel at Pactum Investment Group, he plays a critical role in structuring complex, cross-border transactions involving sovereign capital, multinational investors, and global partnerships. David previously served as a Partner at Addleshaw Goddard and Clifford Chance LLP, where he advised multinational corporations, asset managers, and boards on governance, regulatory strategy, and ESG integration. His work included transition planning, stakeholder alignment, and structuring investment frameworks in highly regulated environments, often across multiple jurisdictions with competing regulatory requirements. His background spans environmental law, human rights, and sports law, providing a multidisciplinary perspective on modern investment challenges. This breadth of experience allows him to approach transactions with a holistic lens, integrating legal rigor with commercial awareness and reputational considerations. David is also the Co-Founder of The Impactors, an initiative focused on generating social and commercial impact across sport, hospitality, and cultural sectors. Through this platform, he has worked with global stakeholders to develop initiatives that align financial performance with measurable social outcomes. He serves on multiple international boards, contributing to governance, oversight, and strategic development across a diverse range of organizations. At Pactum Investment Group, David ensures that investment strategies are supported by robust governance frameworks, enabling the firm to operate effectively across jurisdictions while maintaining institutional standards and integrity.

name: Gabriel Simons
title: Senior Partner
short: Gabriel Simons serves as Senior Partner at Pactum Crownstone United Global Inc. A globally experienced investment executive with more than 25 years across China and international markets, he has held CEO and CFO roles in publicly listed companies across New York and China.
full: Gabriel Simons is a globally experienced investment and strategy executive with more than 25 years of operating experience across China and international markets. As Senior Partner at Pactum Investment Group, he brings deep expertise in cross-border investment, capital formation, and strategic execution. His career has been defined by an ability to bridge Eastern and Western markets, aligning capital with opportunity while navigating complex regulatory, cultural, and commercial landscapes. Throughout his career, Gabriel has held CEO and CFO roles in publicly listed companies across both New York and China, leading organisations through complex, multi-stakeholder environments. He has built strong relationships across government agencies, institutional investors, and private enterprises, positioning him as a key connector between global capital and emerging market opportunities. His deep understanding of regulatory frameworks and market dynamics in both China and Western markets allows him to structure transactions and partnerships that are both compliant and commercially effective. His cross-cultural fluency and strategic mindset enable him to operate seamlessly across diverse markets, fostering trust and alignment among stakeholders with differing priorities. Gabriel is known for his ability to simplify complex challenges and develop clear, actionable strategies that align stakeholders and drive execution. He combines financial discipline with operational insight, ensuring that investment strategies are not only well-structured but also executable in real-world conditions. At Pactum Investment Group, Gabriel contributes to global investment strategy, partnership development, and cross-border initiatives, strengthening the firm's presence across international markets. His perspective is particularly valuable in navigating the evolving dynamics of global trade, capital flows, and geopolitical considerations.

name: Eric J. Ramos
title: Principal Advisor — Fintech & Financial Infrastructure
short: Eric J. Ramos serves as Principal Advisor for Fintech & Financial Infrastructure at Pactum Crownstone United Global Inc. Founder and CEO of eSend, a cross-border financial technology platform, he previously built and exited Pure Minutes, a global telecommunications company operating across 75+ countries.
full: Eric J. Ramos is an entrepreneur, investor, and global financial infrastructure operator with a distinguished track record in building and scaling high-performance platforms across telecommunications, fintech, and private markets. His work focuses on designing systems that align connectivity, capital, and commerce on a global scale, enabling seamless interaction between financial institutions, technology platforms, and emerging market ecosystems. He operates within a family office platform at Vienna Capital Partners, where he leads private market investment activity, capital formation, and syndication across sectors including artificial intelligence, energy, defense, and advanced technologies. As Founder and Chief Executive Officer of eSend, Eric has built a cross-border financial technology platform enabling global settlement and money movement. The platform integrates financial institutions, telecom networks, exchanges, and remittance systems, creating a distributed infrastructure for next-generation finance. Under his leadership, eSend has positioned itself as a critical enabler of real-time, cross-border transactions, addressing longstanding challenges related to liquidity, interoperability, and access within the global financial system. Earlier in his career, Eric founded and successfully exited Pure Minutes, a global telecommunications company, and developed telecommunications infrastructure across more than 75 countries. This infrastructure-first approach enabled scalable growth, operational independence, and global reach, laying the foundation for his later work in financial technology and digital payments. At Pactum Crownstone, Eric provides strategic insight into financial infrastructure, cross-border capital flows, and platform-based investment opportunities, bringing a forward-looking perspective on the evolution of global financial systems.

name: Joseph Barisonzi
title: Principal Advisor — Impact Investing & ESG Strategy
short: Joseph Barisonzi serves as Principal Advisor for Impact Investing & ESG Strategy at Pactum Crownstone United Global Inc. Chief Investment Officer of Lunaris One, he has mobilized more than $200 million in investment activity and serves as an adjunct professor at the Minneapolis College of Art and Design.
full: Joseph Barisonzi is a systems strategist, investor, and organizational architect with more than three decades of experience aligning capital with innovation, sustainability, and long-term societal impact. His work focuses on translating complex, multi-stakeholder systems into scalable investment strategies that integrate financial performance with broader environmental and economic outcomes. As Chief Investment Officer of Lunaris One, Joseph leads investment strategy and partnership development across ESG-aligned sectors, including sustainable infrastructure, alternative energy, and mission-driven innovation. He operates at the intersection of institutional capital and emerging opportunities, identifying platforms capable of generating long-term value while addressing critical global challenges. Over the course of his career, he has mobilized more than $200 million in investment activity across entrepreneurial ventures, impact-oriented initiatives, and emerging growth platforms. He is particularly known for structuring innovative financial models that align investor objectives with long-term societal and environmental impact, often bridging the gap between traditional capital markets and purpose-driven investment strategies. In addition to his investment work, Joseph has held leadership roles in conservation and public governance, contributing to initiatives that address environmental stewardship, land use, and community resilience. He also serves as an adjunct professor at the Minneapolis College of Art and Design, where he teaches entrepreneurship, finance, and organizational systems. At Pactum Crownstone, Joseph provides strategic insight into impact-oriented investment strategies and long-term capital alignment, helping position the firm within evolving global investment paradigms focused on sustainability and resilience.

name: David "Panda" Chen
title: Principal Advisor — Capital Markets & Digital Assets
short: David "Panda" Chen serves as Principal Advisor for Capital Markets & Digital Assets at Pactum Crownstone United Global Inc. Managing Partner of GTIF Capital and former Partner at Deloitte, he combines institutional financial rigor with hands-on execution across private equity, digital assets, and emerging markets.
full: David "Panda" Chen is a global financial advisor and investment strategist with deep expertise in valuation, capital formation, due diligence, and fund strategy. As Managing Partner of GTIF Capital and former Partner at Deloitte, he combines institutional financial rigor with hands-on execution across private equity, venture capital, digital assets, media, sports, and emerging markets. Throughout his career, David has advised companies on building institutional-grade financial models, structuring capital raises, and positioning businesses for scalable growth and strategic exits. His work focuses on transforming companies into investable platforms by aligning financial performance, narrative, partnerships, and market demand. He has led and supported capital strategies ranging from early-stage raises to institutional funding rounds, including initiatives targeting $20M-$25M and beyond. His experience spans mergers and acquisitions, investment structuring, and global partnership development, with a strong emphasis on cross-border capital flows and emerging market opportunities. David has also been at the forefront of crypto and Web3 investment strategy, advising on tokenization frameworks, digital asset valuation, and ecosystem development. His work integrates traditional financial principles with next-generation investment models, enabling companies to access new forms of capital and monetization. In addition to his financial expertise, David has developed global initiatives across Africa and other emerging markets, working with government stakeholders, media platforms, and investment groups to build scalable, multi-market strategies. At Pactum Crownstone, David serves as an Advisor, supporting valuation strategy, capital formation, and institutional positioning, ensuring that investment platforms are structured to maximize enterprise value and attract the right capital partners.

name: Louis Jimenez
title: Principal Advisor — Latin America & Cross-Border Investments
short: Louis Jimenez serves as Principal Advisor for Latin America & Cross-Border Investments at Pactum Crownstone United Global Inc. Founder and CEO of PH-PLUS International, he holds an MBA, JD, and LL.M. from the University of Southern California and brings over three decades of cross-border investment experience.
full: Louis Jimenez is a globally experienced executive, investor, and entrepreneur with more than three decades of leadership across private equity, venture capital, mergers and acquisitions, and cross-border finance. He has built a strong reputation for identifying high-value opportunities, structuring complex international transactions, and guiding organizations through growth and market expansion. As Founder and CEO of PH-PLUS International, he leads a cross-border investment platform focused on Latin America and the Caribbean. The firm specializes in sourcing, structuring, and executing investment opportunities across sectors including energy, infrastructure, agriculture, real estate, and financial technologies. Under his leadership, PH-PLUS International has developed a strong regional network of government relationships, institutional partners, and private capital sources. Mr. Jimenez holds an MBA, Juris Doctor, and Master of Laws from the University of Southern California, providing a rare combination of financial, legal, and operational expertise. This multidisciplinary background enables him to navigate complex global transactions with a comprehensive understanding of regulatory frameworks, capital structuring, and execution strategy. At Pactum Crownstone, Mr. Jimenez provides strategic guidance on cross-border investments, emerging markets, and global capital flows, strengthening the firm's international positioning and long-term investment capabilities. He works closely with leadership and investment teams to identify opportunities in high-growth regions, develop strategic partnerships, and structure transactions that meet the expectations of institutional and private capital providers.

name: Ambassador Koby A. Koomson
title: Principal Advisor — Emerging Markets & Africa Strategy
short: Ambassador Koby A. Koomson serves as Principal Advisor for Emerging Markets & Africa Strategy at Pactum Crownstone United Global Inc. A former Ghanaian Ambassador to the United States, he helped increase U.S. EXIM Bank financing into Ghana from $67 million to over $850 million and was the first African ambassador appointed to the U.S. Export-Import Bank's Sub-Saharan Africa Advisory Board.
full: Ambassador Koby A. Koomson is a globally recognized investment strategist and former Ghanaian Ambassador to the United States, with deep expertise across private equity, infrastructure finance, and cross-border capital formation in emerging markets. During his diplomatic tenure (1997-2001), he played a pivotal role in catalyzing U.S.-Africa investment flows, helping increase U.S. EXIM Bank financing into Ghana from approximately $67 million to over $850 million within three years. He also served on the U.S. Export-Import Bank's Sub-Saharan Africa Advisory Board, becoming the first African ambassador appointed to this position. Ambassador Koomson was instrumental in advancing landmark frameworks that reshaped Africa's investment landscape, including advocacy for the U.S.-Africa Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) and the establishment of the OPIC-backed Africa Infrastructure Fund - unlocking institutional capital for large-scale development projects. He has successfully negotiated and delivered complex bilateral agreements spanning trade, telecommunications, agriculture, energy, and aviation - creating durable platforms for foreign direct investment and long-term economic growth between Africa and global markets. Beyond public service, Ambassador Koomson has been active in private markets for over two decades, advising transactions and investment strategies across Africa, Asia, and the Americas. He has led and participated in global investment missions in sectors including energy, telecommunications, financial services, agriculture, and mining. Currently, he is Chairman and CEO of Bluetone Communications Ghana and remains actively involved in large-scale commercial agriculture, aquaculture, and telecommunications ventures. Ambassador Koomson is widely regarded as a thought leader in real-world asset (RWA) investment strategies, particularly in aligning institutional capital with high-growth frontier markets.

name: Christopher Najbicz
title: Principal Advisor — Real Estate & Hospitality
short: Christopher Najbicz serves as Principal Advisor for Real Estate & Hospitality at Pactum Crownstone United Global Inc. A former Vice President at Caesars Entertainment, he has opened more than 50 hotels and resorts worldwide across four continents over a career spanning more than three decades.
full: Christopher Najbicz is a highly accomplished global hospitality executive with more than three decades of experience leading large-scale operations, development, and strategic initiatives across luxury hotels, integrated resorts, and lifestyle-driven destinations worldwide. His career spans four continents, with direct experience across Africa, Europe, the Middle East, Asia-Pacific, and the Americas. He has led the conceptualization, design, development, opening, and operation of a broad portfolio of hotel and integrated resort projects globally, including high-end lifestyle and wellness-focused destinations. His work has focused on aligning operational performance, brand positioning, and guest experience to maximize long-term asset value and profitability. Christopher previously held senior executive roles at Caesars Entertainment, where he served as Vice President of Corporate Hospitality and Vice President of Corporate Hotel Operations. In these roles, he led enterprise-wide strategy, implemented operational standards across multiple regions, and oversaw development, refurbishment, and performance optimization across a large global hospitality portfolio. Throughout his career, Christopher has opened more than 50 hotels and resorts worldwide and has developed deep expertise in conceptual design, pre- and post-opening execution, operational efficiency, and brand creation. He is known for his ability to identify market opportunities, implement high-impact strategies, and deliver measurable improvements in both performance and guest experience. At Pactum Crownstone, Christopher works selectively as a strategic advisor on high-value hospitality, real estate, and integrated lifestyle investment initiatives. His involvement is focused on projects where his expertise, global network, and operational insight can materially enhance outcomes and support the firm's expansion into experiential and asset-backed investment opportunities.
